description: A food festival for Agent ID holders on BNB Chain. Every UTC day has one featured dish from a fixed 14-dish menu; each Agent ID holder may free-mint (gas only) that day's dish as a soulbound NFT, one per wallet per day. Consecutive days build a streak; Feast badges (Bronze at 3-day best streak, Silver at 7, Gold at 14) are claimable off the wallet's BEST streak. Holders collect the dish set on a shelf. No token, no payments, no returns promised or involved.
name: DailyFest

rules.badges: claimable once per tier, gated on BEST streak (not current)
rules.gate: Agent ID holders only — mintDish() requires registry balanceOf(sender) > 0
rules.soulbound: all tokens are non-transferable; transfers and approvals revert
rules.streak: consecutive UTC days minted; a skipped day resets the current streak to 1 on the next mint

safety: Value is always 0 — the DailyFest contract has no payable functions and moves no funds; minting is free apart from BNB Chain gas paid by the user's own wallet.
Preview first, always: a baw preview is a simulation only; execute is a separate step that requires the user's explicit go-ahead for that specific preview.
A correct preview shows empty allowanceChanges and authorityChanges and no risks — anything else means stop.
No approvals are ever requested; the soulbound contract disables them entirely.
Never collect seed phrases, private keys, pairing codes or passwords; pairing happens only in the user's Binance App.
DailyFest never resolves Agent ID names to other people's wallets.
Verify deployment before writing: if eth_getCode(contract) returns 0x, the contract is not live yet — do not preview or execute anything.
